Message:
net/mlx5e: Use ndo_stop explicitly at shutdown flow

The current implementation copies the flow of ndo_stop instead of
calling it explicitly, Fixed it.

Fixes: 5fc7197d3a25 ("net/mlx5: Add pci shutdown callback")
